newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR generally mixed ahead of auction.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR generally mixed ahead of auction.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Monday as banks awaited the results of the regular weekly treasury bill auction later in the day, traders said.
"Many banks were still uncertain on how the rates will move in today's auction. Personally, I believe that it will stay at the current levels or even lower," one trader said.
Other expected rates to move higher after the Central Bank went on a dollar-selling binge last Friday, siphoning off pesos from the market.
The three-month and six-month PHIBOR were slightly lower, while the two-week PHIBOR inched up marginally. Other maturities remained stuck at their Friday's levels.
PHIBOR are average rates of foreign exchange forward quotes of 20 banks operating in the country.
